entities.summary: Aichi Prefectural University  is a public university located in the city of Nagakute, Aichi, Japan. There is a campus in Moriyama-ku, Nagoya which is for the nursing school, namely Aichi Prefectural College of Nursing & Health. The predecessor of the school was founded in 1947, and it was chartered as a university in 1966.
